name: InsertColumnIntoDataTableNode
label: Insert Column Into Data Table
description: Inserts a new column into the data table either at the end or before a specific column index.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: ColumnName
fields.label: Column Name
fields.description: The name of the new column.

fields.name: DataType
fields.label: Data Type
fields.description: Data type of the new column (e.g., String, Int, Decimal, etc).

selectOptions.label: Decimal
selectOptions.description: Represents a high-precision decimal number, typically used for financial calculations.

selectOptions.label: DateTime
selectOptions.description: Represents a date and time value.

selectOptions.label: Boolean
selectOptions.description: Represents a true or false logical value.

fields.name: InsertLocation
fields.label: Insert Location
fields.description: Position where the new column will be inserted.

selectOptions.label: End of Data Table
selectOptions.description: Insert at the end of the data table.

selectOptions.label: Before Column Index
selectOptions.description: Insert before a specific column index.

fields.name: ColumnIndex
fields.label: Column Index
fields.description: Index to insert column at (used only if 'Before Column Index').

fields.name: ModifiedDataTable
fields.label: Modified Data Table
fields.description: The updated data table with the new column.
